data.text: I’m with Emma: **15 tons today; $15,000 donated**, provided all four donations are committed before we fish and Luke keeps his zero-catch pledge. Our families depend on both the clinic and this lake, so the recovery plan needs to be part of today’s agreement—not an afterthought. I commit to **6 tons next month under a shared 30-ton cap**, then **10 tons a month under the 50-ton ceiling** once the lake is back at 100. John, will you join us on the donation and those limits?
